query: The Second Party {Past two, the landlady catches your sleeve on the stair. "Another party's just come up, and I'm a pair of hands short. Same pay again."|A second party is coming up the stair as yours goes down it. The landlady looks at you and raises an eyebrow.|"One more," says the landlady, "and I'll owe you." The castle will be waking in four hours.} Stay till dawn {You take your jacket back off the peg. The second party is louder than the first.|You splash cold water on your face and go back up. The lamps are still lit, and so are the guests.|You stay. It will be light when you get home, and the castle's early risers will see you come in.} Go home to bed {You hand back the jacket and walk home under the last of the stars. Your bed has never been so welcome.|"Next time," you tell the landlady. You're asleep before the castle clock strikes three.|You leave the second party to someone else and sleep the four hours you have left like a stone.}
